run_label_note: File and run are labeled 2026-10-31 (the resolution run name); the clock time of writing is created_at, and the OpenTimestamps receipt beside this file is the outside record of when it existed.
why_an_addendum: The 2026-10-30 rule covers only rows whose resolution_date has passed, and its V3 rule is a closed list. Neither covers an open row whose criterion is defective as written before its resolution date. This addendum adds one rule, V4, and nothing else. Every 'never' commitment in the 2026-10-30 file still applies, except the bar on voiding before the resolution date, which V4 lifts for its listed rows only.

void_rules.definition: An open row whose resolution criterion names a broadcaster as a required source of the counted events, where that broadcaster no longer holds the rights for the period the criterion covers. The criterion is unresolvable as written: counting without that broadcaster reinterprets it, and keeping it would require choices made after the schedule is known. The row is voided, not scored on a reinterpreted criterion.
void_rules.void_reason: criterion references a broadcaster that no longer holds the rights; unresolvable as written
void_rules.selection: Applied only to the rows listed in items, each with its reason.

items.pred_nba26_nba26_d4: Criterion counts 'ABC/ESPN/TNT/NBA TV national broadcasts' for the 2026-27 season. TNT does not carry NBA games under the national media deals that began with the 2025-26 season; 2026-27 national games are on ESPN/ABC, NBC/Peacock, Prime Video and NBA TV.

disclosure: This rule was written after the 2026-27 national TV schedule was public. On the schedule, the row would likely have resolved YES on intent (Yahoo Sports 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-03 report 6 national games on ESPN/ABC, NBC/Peacock and Prime plus 4 on NBA TV). The locked probability is 0.85, so voiding removes a likely favorable score rather than an unfavorable one. The rule looks only at the criterion text and the rights holders, not at the outcome.
labeling: Same as the 2026-10-30 file: voided rows keep every locked field, get status 'voided', void_reason, void_rule, voided_at, void_prereg (this file name and its sha256) and an audit flag 'voided_2026-10-31:V4_defunct_rights_holder'. They are excluded from Brier and listed on the public page and in RESOLUTION_REPORT_2026-10-31.md.
